service.operator: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Ministry of Land, Government of Bangladesh; local lead: Rangunia Upazila Land Office
service.serviceType: Public HTML/JavaScript map viewer with anonymous POST endpoints
service.serviceEvidence: HTTP 200 HTML and current MapSearch.js were fetched. The JS calls /Map/GetDivisionList, /Khatian/getdistrictlistdivisionwise, /Khatian/GetSurveyListDistrictWise, /Khatian/GetThanaListBySurveyMap, /Khatian/GetMouzaListBySurveyMap, /Khatian/GetSheetJsonBySurvey, and /tiles/parcels/{rsnum}/{comcod}/{unitcod}/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf.
service.localCustodianEvidence: The official Rangunia Upazila Land Office portal (https://acl.rangunia.chittagong.gov.bd/pages/officers) identifies the Assistant Commissioner (Land); Chattogram’s official employee listing also identifies the Rangunia Upazila Land Office. This supports local registry/procedure custody, while DLRS supplies the national public map workflow.
